patterns.note: Full-bleed horizontal scrolling content strips are used to showcase artists and press, maintaining their vertical position in the viewport while their content scrolls continuously.
Prominent use of a very bold, condensed, uppercase sans-serif display font for scrolling text elements, creating a high-impact, almost urgent visual rhythm.
A high-contrast palette features a dominant black background, crisp white text, and vibrant, almost neon, accent colors (pink, red, orange, green, yellow) for text backgrounds and the 3D logo.
The main 'TOAST' candle logo in the hero section scales down and translates upwards with a subtle parallax effect as the user scrolls, receding into the background.

Continuous horizontal scrolling carousels, likely powered by Swiper, are used for artist names, artist images, and magazine covers, creating dynamic content streams that are vertically sticky within the viewport.

technique_notes: The hero section features a large 3D graphic that scales down and translates upwards with a parallax effect as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth and revealing content below.

Content is organized into full-width horizontal scrolling carousels, implemented with a library like Swiper, which maintain their vertical position on the screen while their internal content scrolls continuously from right to left, showcasing a stream of items.
A minimalist top navigation bar and a media player bar at the bottom remain sticky to the viewport, providing constant access and functionality.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely large, condensed, uppercase display headings (~6-8x body) for scrolling elements, paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for navigation and footer text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, with no visible rounded elements.
design_tokens.spacing: An airy hero section with significant negative space transitions into dense, full-bleed content strips that fill the width and height of their respective sections.

standout: The site's distinctive use of continuously scrolling horizontal content strips, combined with a bold, almost brutalist color palette and a playful 3D hero logo, creates a highly dynamic and engaging visual experience that breaks from typical static section layouts. If a builder copied only one idea, it should be the implementation of these vertically sticky, horizontally scrolling content carousels.
